one_line: 克利夫兰美术馆藏画作，馆方断代作「1690s」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

Purchase from the J. H. Wade Fund

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → qing；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Tō Sō Gen Min meigaten-gō [唐宋元明名画展号]. Tōkyō: Tōkyō Asahi Shinbun Hakkōjo, 1928.（II, pl. 256）
Harada, Kinjirō 原田謹次郎. Shina meiga hōkan [支那名畫寶鑒 = The pageant of Chinese painting]. Tōkyō: Ōtsuka Kōgeisha, 1936.（Reproduced: pl. 775）
Mei Qushan hua ji 梅瞿山画集. Shanghai: [Shanghai ren min mei shu chu ban she], 1960.（Reproduced: pl. 2）
Lee, Sherman E. "The Year in Review for 1979." The Bulletin of the Cleveland Museum of Art 67, no. 3 (1980): 58-99.（Reproduced: cat. no. 117, p. 85）

Ho, Wai-kam, Sherman E. Lee, Laurence Sickman, and Marc F. Wilson. Eight Dynasties of Chinese Painting: The Collections of the Nelson Gallery-Atkins Museum, Kansas City, and the Cleveland Museum of Art. Cleveland, OH: Cleveland Museum of Art, in cooperation with Indiana University Press, 1980.（Reproduced: cat. no. 229, p. 320）
**馆方记录另有 4 条著录未在此列出。**

dating.text: 馆方给出了年代，**但未在公开记录中说明这个年代依据什么**——是铭文、器形序列、共出器物还是风格比对，无从得知。本库的断代十档因此无法填写：**填任何一档都是替馆方作了它没作的声明。**

colophons.text:
太古蟄龍醒，蠺叢霹靂開。 
五溪雲不去，三峽雪飛來。

瞿山, 清。 [印] 梅清; 淵公

馆方英译：Artist's inscription, signature, and 2 seals:

In remote age, the hibernating dragon is awoken,/
As the ancient King Cancong, it split the land asunder/
Clouds do not descend onto the land of Five Streams./
But snow does fly here from the Three Gorges.

Qushan, Qing. [seals] Mei Qing; Yuangong.
2 additional seals: 1 of Dai Xi 戴煕 (1801–1860); 1 unidentified.
以上为克利夫兰美术馆藏品记录里的题跋与钤印著录，**本库未核对原件**；款印的真伪、题跋者身份与年代均未独立判定。

provenance.text: (Yabumoto Shogoro 藪本莊五郎 [1900s], Amagasaki, Hyogo, Japan, sold to the Cleveland Museum of Art)
The Cleveland Museum of Art, Cleveland, OH
以上递藏链照录自馆方档案。**本库未独立核实其中任一环节**；经手人身份、交易性质与时间点均以馆方记录为准，本库不据此判定流散性质。
